string.text: Hello. Why are you sitting in the dark?
From whom? Everyone here seems friendly.
They're watching me, waiting for me to fall asleep. But I'm hiding, I'm keeping watch. This is my stuff. I collected it, and they want to take it for nothing!
What treasure have you got? I don't quite understand...
My things! I saw them first. That's my bucket and my table.
So you're guarding a pile of junk.
You're junk! These are valuable things. If they'd asked nicely, I'd have traded. But they just want me to hand it over for nothing! Can you imagine?
That's not very nice of them.
That's what I'm saying. You understand me. Want a folding workbench? You're decent. I can sell it to you.
Interesting. What do you want for it?
Ten cans of meat, and it's yours. If anything else in my collection catches your eye, I'll trade it for money.
Got it. Thanks for the offer.
Here, I brought ten cans of meat.
Good, good. Here you go. But don't give it to them. Those rude fools can do without!
Wait, I can't make the exchange right now. Come back in a moment.
All right, I'll leave you to it.
